dealbreakers.as_sentence: The interview did not put this to the candidate, and did not observe it either way. This is a gap in the interview, not a finding about the candidate.

summary: A specific account of fine-tuning and quantising a 14B model under memory limits, with a measured check after quantisation. Production ownership showed in a real drift incident and the check added afterwards. System design stayed at the level of components and has not been load tested. Evaluation design was not established; one inconsistency about evaluation set size was asked about once and not resolved.
